title: SAFEINFER: Context Adaptive Decoding Time Safety Alignment for Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the 'safety and ethical alignment' of LLMs. It introduces the HarmEval benchmark and uses datasets like NicheHazardQA to evaluate models on 'unethical questions' and 'ethical guidelines,' including hate speech, discrimination, and propaganda. The evaluation methodology explicitly asks if content 'adheres to ethical standards.'
